node.name: Arc at infinity in Nyquist plot
node.name_en: Arc at infinity in Nyquist plot

definition: Arc at infinity in Nyquist plot：An arc at infinity in the Nyquist plot occurs when there is a pole on the imaginary axis, such as at ω=0.
intuition: 在图谱邻接中可把握：后续 → C1 contour。
